title: Unused Value List
description: Unused-code rule — value lists not attached to any field / layout object, sort order or external wrapper. Findings in files exported without DDR info are marked unverified.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Orphaned value lists clutter the definitions and can drift out of date.
rule.remediation: Delete the value list, or attach it where it is meant to be used. In a file exported without DDR info formula references are missing, so its findings are marked unverified — export it again with DDR info before deleting.
